articles.title: Coldcard exploit pushes July losses to $247M as second-worst month of 2026
articles.snippet: The Coldcard exploit, which caused more than $100 million in losses, helped push July crypto thefts to $247 million, making it the second-worst month of 2026.

articles.title: Bitget explores licensed crypto presence in Bhutan
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Bitget has signed an agreement with Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority to pursue a regulated local presence.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows surge after Coldcard hack, but link is unclear: Bloomberg analyst
articles.snippet: A week-long streak of inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs has coincided with the Coldcard wallet exploit, fueling debate over whether some investors are shifting away from self-custody.
